about: How a protagonist comes into a settlement, by the country it stands in: the way's name, the scene of the town coming into sight, and a sign of the life going on there as they come (now), which the first place opens on once an opening has told the scene (OWN-17, OWN-18); and what each trade looks like from the road.

marsh.name: the causeway into {home}
marsh.scene: The causeway runs on its piles across the last of the fen, and at the end of it is {home}: low roofs against the sky, {sight}, {trade}, smoke going straight up from the chimneys.
marsh.now: Someone is cutting reed in the ditch beside the causeway, up to the knees in it, and straightens to watch you go by.

forest.name: the road into {home}
forest.scene: The road comes out from under the trees, and there is {home} in its clearing: {sight}, {trade}, smoke from a dozen chimneys.
forest.now: Somewhere ahead an axe is going, and a dog at the first house has started barking at the sound of you.

mountain.name: the road down into {home}
mountain.scene: The road comes down off the high ground in long zigzags, and {home} is below you at the foot of it: stone roofs, {sight}, {trade}, the chimneys smoking.
mountain.now: A child minding goats on the slope above the road stands up to watch you come down, and shouts something to the houses below.

frost.name: the road into {home}
frost.scene: The road comes in between the snow-fences, and {home} is ahead of you: low roofs weighted with turf, {sight}, {trade}, a dog barking at nothing.
frost.now: A woman cutting turf by the last of the fences straightens to watch you come, and calls something back over her shoulder to the houses.

desert.name: the track into {home}
desert.scene: The track comes in across the stony ground between lines of white stones, and {home} is ahead of you: flat roofs and mud walls the colour of the sand, {sight}, {trade}, the palms over the well.
desert.now: A boy watering goats at the trough looks up to watch you come in out of the glare, and calls something over his shoulder to the houses.

trade.charcoal: the blue smoke of the charcoal hearths
trade.timber: timber stacked to season along the road
trade.honey: bee-skeps in rows along the garden walls
trade.tin: spoil heaps grey above the roofs
trade.furs: pelts stretched on frames by the doors
